actual: Regression after verified BUG-996/BUG-1023: durable run macb_idem_512dce37bdd1e0096eed1615438d41e35e67966d completed two sequential WSL children in about 7 minutes but wrote 583 events. 274 were claimed/waiting_capacity and 274 were status/waiting_capacity (548 rows, about 94%). While one child held node_parallelism=1, the queued sibling was reclaimed and persisted roughly every 0.8 seconds. Fix must preserve strict capacity=1 and immediate wake on real capacity release, but unchanged waiting-capacity state must not emit repeated claim/status events or DB DML; use bounded state-aware retry/throttle, retain fencing/idempotency/restart recovery, and add multi-child regression tests. Refs prior BUG-996 and BUG-1023 as incomplete path coverage. Runtime backend-main BUG; no backend process control, DDL/DML, dependency install, event cleanup, or experiment mutation.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.

events.note: dispatch treated every unchanged waiting_capacity retry as completed work: it claimed the queued attempt, emitted claim/status evidence, and self-woke again instead of performing a bounded read-only capacity observation.

Waiting attempts now use snapshot-fenced dispatch plus node-coalesced read-only capacity observation; unchanged full capacity performs zero source DML/events, real same-node release clears the cooldown immediately, and deferred nodes do not block other dispatch work.
Final related multi_alpha matrix passed 240 tests with 13 environment skips; required validation_module_registry_l0 and qe_read_backend plans also passed.
A fresh Python process imported the tracked orchestrator and verified capacity cooldown plus same-node release behavior without backend process control.

expected: A queued sibling may record one initial waiting_capacity transition, then unchanged full-node checks must be read-only, event-free, node-coalesced, and bounded to no more than once per minute; a real same-node capacity release must wake the sibling immediately without weakening strict capacity, fencing, idempotency, restart recovery, or other-node throughput.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
